policy: All submissions subtrees, unrelated queue/previous-job bodies, transport retrieval snapshots and admission preflight/original execution bodies are omitted. The new execution_scientific.json files preserve unchanged scientific provenance/resource/process values and exactly the attempt_mode/start_unix/end_unix values consumed by the unchanged raw-math auditor. All original hashes remain provenance-only; originals stay private and unmodified.
